# `FluxRegisterOverlayFn`

<span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge-ABI">ABI</span> <span class="sdk-kind">callback</span>

Source: **ABI v4** (`src/plugins/abi.rs`). Generated group: **Methods**.

## Description

Callback used by plugins to register one overlay descriptor.

## Signature

```rust
pub type FluxRegisterOverlayFn = unsafe extern "C" fn (context : * mut c_void , descriptor : * const FluxOverlayDescriptor ,) -> FluxStatus;
```

| Argument | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |

## SDK Example

_Source: [`examples/methods/fluxregisteroverlayfn.md`](../../examples/methods/fluxregisteroverlayfn.md)_

```rust
unsafe fn register_overlay(
    callback: FluxRegisterOverlayFn,
    context: *mut std::ffi::c_void,
) -> FluxStatus {
    let descriptor = FluxOverlayDescriptor {
        id: FluxUtf8Slice::from_str("flux.demo.overlay.temperature"),
        label: FluxUtf8Slice::from_str("Temperature"),
        hotkey: FluxUtf8Slice::from_str("F9"),
        render_policy: 1,
    };
    unsafe { callback(context, &descriptor) }
}
```
